content.json:
# Entra External ID: identity security console
Two filters drive everything: **workspace** and **time range** (TimeGenerated). `ResultType 0` = success; `50074/50076/50058/50140` are MFA or session prompts and are shown separately from real failures. Users are shown by sign-in email (AlternateSignInName) when present, else UserPrincipalName.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend S=parse_json(tostring(Status)), L=parse_json(tostring(LocationDetails)), D=parse_json(tostring(DeviceDetail))
| extend User=tolower(case(isnotempty(AlternateSignInName), tostring(AlternateSignInName), isnotempty(UserPrincipalName), tostring(UserPrincipalName), "(unknown)")),
         DisplayName=iff(isempty(UserDisplayName),"(no display name)",tostring(UserDisplayName)),
         Country=coalesce(tostring(L.countryOrRegion), tostring(Location)), City=tostring(L.city), State=tostring(L.state),
         Browser=tostring(split(tostring(D.browser)," ")[0]), OS=tostring(D.operatingSystem),
         ErrorCode=tostring(S.errorCode), FailureReason=tostring(S.failureReason), AdditionalDetails=tostring(S.additionalDetails),
         Outcome=case(ResultType=="0","Success",ResultType in ("50074","50076","50058","50140"),"MFA / prompt","Failure")
| summarize Value=toreal(count())
| project Metric="Total sign-ins", Value
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time window
